messages:
Maya: Quick recs please — need short stories (<10k words) for my 20‑min commute and a few 3–4 min songs to loop. Drop your go-tos!
Jon: The Paper Menagerie — Ken Liu. 10 min, will wreck you. Also 'Bullet in the Brain' by Tobias Wolff if you want a punchy one-liner ending.
Priya: Exhalation (Ted Chiang) — thoughtful and short. For songs: 'Electric Feel' — MGMT (3:50) or 'Bad Habit' — Steve Lacy (3:02).
Sam: If you like weird magical realism: 'St. Lucy's Home for Girls Raised by Wolves' (Karen Russell). Song rec: 'Dreams' by Fleetwood Mac — commute comfort. :sunrise:
Lina: Interpreter of Maladies (Jhumpa Lahiri) is slightly longer but works in bits. Also love microfiction: check 'Flash Fiction Online' for <1k pieces. Song: 'Take On Me' — perfect 3:46 upbeat loop.
book-bot: New reading list posted: https://www.tor.com/short-fiction/ — curated picks and links.
Maya: Nice, thanks! Any microfiction recs (<500 words)? Perfect for coffee breaks.
Jon: Classic micro: Hemingway's six-word story — "For sale: baby shoes, never worn." Always hits.
Priya: 'Girl' (Katherine Mansfield) is tiny and sharp. Also check 'Sudden Fiction' anthologies.
Sam: Poll: react with :book: for short stories, :memo: for microfiction, :musical_note: for songs.
Lina: :book: (short stories)
Jon: :memo: (microfiction)
Maya: :musical_note: songs — I think I'll make a 20-min commute playlist out of these. Anyone wants it?
Priya: Yes pls! Add some instrumental or lo-fi too.
Sam: I'll toss in 'Night Owl' — Galimatias remix (3:20). Good chill.
book-bot: Saved playlist template: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/example — editable by anyone.
Maya: Sent playlist link in DM to folks who asked. Thanks for the recs — will report back which short story made me cry on the train. :cry:
